_about.purpose: Fix the words that YouTube's automatic captions mishear, mostly gym vocabulary. Without these fixes, a search for 'deload' or 'hack squat' finds nothing, because the captions wrote 'dilode' and 'axquat'.
_about.when_applied: After the sound tags are removed and before the passages are built. The raw transcript files are never changed: corrections only apply to the cleaned copy.
how_matching_works: Each 'pattern' is a regular expression, matched case-insensitively (DILODE, Dilode and dilode are all caught).
Rules run on the whole transcript of a video, so an error split across two caption pieces ('push' | 'pool legs') is still caught.
Rules run from top to bottom, in the order of this file. Each rule sees the text already fixed by the rules above it.
Every hit is counted per video in data/corpus/corrections_log.csv.

regex_cheat_sheet.\\b: word boundary: the match must start or end a whole word. '\bdilo\b' catches 'dilo' on its own, not inside a longer word.
regex_cheat_sheet.a|b: either a or b: 'pration|prenation' catches both spellings.
regex_cheat_sheet.s?: the letter before is optional: 'dilodes?' catches 'dilode' and 'dilodes'.
regex_cheat_sheet.(?:a|b): a group of choices, without capturing it: 'push (?:pool|poule) legs' catches both.
regex_cheat_sheet.(...) and \\1: a captured group reused in the replacement: 'développer (couché|incliné)' becomes 'développé couché' or 'développé incliné'.
regex_cheat_sheet.?: an optional space: 'face ?pool' catches 'facepool' and 'face pool'.

fields.category: what kind of error it is: training_term, exercise_name, anatomy, body_composition, spelling, person_name.
fields.description: plain-language explanation of what the rule catches and why.
fields.status: 'confirmed' = checked in context in the transcripts. 'needs_review' = likely, but check the example against the video before trusting it.
fields.example: a real phrase from the corpus where the error appears (empty when not recorded).

how_to_add_a_rule: 1. Find the misheard word in data/corpus/clean_txt/ (or in a search result).
2. Add an entry: pattern with \b around the word, replacement, category, description, status 'needs_review' and a real example.
3. Make the pattern strict enough not to catch correct words (test it on a few transcripts).
4. Rerun build_corpus.py, coverage_report.py and chunker.py, then check corrections_log.csv for the hit count.
5. Switch status to 'confirmed' once checked in context.
_about.limits: This map only fixes errors that someone already spotted. Other misheard words certainly remain in the corpus.

corrections.description: Catches the many ways the captions mishear 'deload' (a lighter training week): 'dilode', 'diload', 'dilo', 'dit laude', 'dodade'. The correct word never appears in the raw captions, so this rule is what makes the deload video findable at all.
corrections.example: c'est apres cette phase de dilode qu'intervient la surcompensation

corrections.description: Catches 'push pool legs' and 'push poule legs', the misheard name of the push / pull / legs training split.
corrections.example: le push pool legs, le full body

corrections.description: Catches 'séance pool', the misheard name of a 'pull' session (back and biceps day).
corrections.example: je la mettrai plus dans une séance pool

corrections.description: Catches 'perlower' and 'per lower', the misheard name of the upper body / lower body split.
corrections.example: le full body, le perlower, le split

corrections.description: Catches 'facepool', 'face pool' and 'faceol', misheard names of the face pull (cable exercise for the rear shoulders).
Catches 'racpool' and 'rac pool', the misheard rack pull (a deadlift started from a raised position).
corrections.example: le racpool c'est en fait un souleve de terre

corrections.description: Catches 'axquat' and 'axwat', the misheard hack squat machine.
corrections.example: le hack squat mais attention le axquat lineaire

corrections.description: Catches 'isquot', the misheard 'ischios' (hamstrings).
corrections.example: equilibrees entre les isquot et les quadriceps

corrections.description: Catches 'mass grass', 'masse grass' and 'grassce' variants of 'masse grasse' (body fat). The most frequent error in the corpus.
Catches 'dorseaux', a misspelling of 'dorsaux' (lats, back muscles).
Catches 'pration' and 'prenation', misheard 'pronation' (palm-down grip or rotation of the forearm).
Catches 'deème' and 'deuxème', truncated forms of 'deuxième' (second).
Catches 'troisème', a truncated form of 'troisième' (third).
Catches 'chromion', the misheard 'acromion' (bony tip of the shoulder blade).
Catches 'rwing', the misheard 'rowing' (row exercise).
Catches 'palof', the misspelled Pallof press (anti-rotation core exercise).
Catches 'pc deck', the misheard pec deck (chest fly machine).
Catches 'alters' and 'altères', the misheard or misspelled 'haltères' (dumbbells).
corrections.example: en serrant les alters l'un contre l'autre

corrections.description: Catches 'soulever terre', 'soulever de terre' and 'soulev de terre', normalizing them to 'soulevé de terre' (deadlift).

Catches 'développer' (the verb) when it is followed by a press variation (couché, incliné, semi-incliné, décliné, militaire, assis, épaules), and turns it into the exercise name 'développé ...' (bench press, incline press, shoulder press...). The variation word is kept as it was.
Catches 'molets', a misspelling of 'mollets' (calves).
Catches 'sur compensation' written in two words, normalizing it to 'surcompensation' (the rebound in performance after recovery).
Catches 'overiching' and 'overaching', the misheard 'overreaching' (short period of deliberately excessive training load).
Catches 'tibodo', the misheard name of the coach Christian Thibaudeau.
Catches 'uberman', the misheard name of Andrew Huberman.
Catches 'menzer', the misheard name of the bodybuilder Mike Mentzer (heavy duty, low volume training).
Catches 'nubray', the misheard name of the bodybuilder Serge Nubret.
Catches 'legl', probably the misheard 'leg curl' (hamstring machine). To review: confirm by listening to the passage.
corrections.example: des séries de 15 sur le legl

corrections.description: Catches 'drakker', probably the misheard 'drag curl' (biceps exercise), in the biceps ranking video. To review: confirm by listening to the passage.
corrections.example: biceps ranking: on va commencer par le pire, le drakker
